title: Home Space Web — settings and administration

LostAndFound.dc.html.title: Lost & Found — shown only while it holds restored files

n_nav.text:
Navigation — changes

• Same frame as the desktop redesign: a sidebar with Files and Recycle bin, search in the page header. Devices leaves the sidebar / app bar.
• Lost & Found moves out of the Home listing into the sidebar, under Recycle bin, as on the desktop. It shows only while it holds restored files (sam has some; maria has none, so her sidebar has no entry).
• Sidebar footer: a storage card (used / free, from GET /storage) and the account button.
• The account button opens a menu upwards: name + sign-in method, Settings, Administration (only when /me says is_admin), Log out.
• Not an admin: the same menu without Administration. The server still answers 403 on /admin/*.
• Settings and Administration are pages in the main column, with tabs; the sidebar stays so the way back to files is one click.

n_settings.text:
Settings — changes

• /settings/account: who you are, how you sign in, change password (password users only; SSO users get a line saying it is managed by the provider), storage use split into files / versions / recycle bin with links to free space.
• /settings/devices: today's /devices page moved here, same list, same row menu (Rename, Sign out). The old /devices route redirects.

n_admin.text:
Administration — changes

• /admin/status: disk use (home-space data / other / free, with the free-space reserve), counts, and the effective configuration, read-only, each with the environment variable that sets it. Secrets are never shown, only “Set”.
• /admin/users: table with role, sign-in method, usage bar against the quota, devices, last seen, state. Filters: All, Admins, Disabled. Row menu: Edit, Reset password, Make admin / Remove admin, Disable / Enable, Delete.
• Add user: local user with a password or a one-time reset link (no mailer, so the admin copies it).
• Edit user: a side panel; SSO users are read-only apart from admin, quota and disable. Delete asks for the username to be typed.
• Guard rails from admin-panel.md: an admin cannot remove their own admin flag or disable themselves if they are the last admin; admins never see other users' files.

Proposals beyond the plan (drop if unwanted): the free-space reserve row, the server version line, the Copy link step.
